svg.aria-label: Safety case h07. After a fill of 10 at 100 and an accepted stop acknowledgement, protection is ACTIVE at version 1. A stale callback at version 0 reports CANCELLED. JCode ignores it because the version is not newer; protection stays ACTIVE. Pi-Bolt and Hax apply it, leaving the open position unprotected, and fail the gate.
svg.title: Why one stale callback decided the ranking
